description: This file defines the class DeployedSubpanelImplementation, which extends AbstractMetaDataImplementation and implements MetaDataImplementationInterface. It manages subpanel definitions for a module, including loading, saving, and maintaining historical versions of subpanel layouts within SuiteCRM. The class handles retrieving layout definitions, interacting with SubPanelDefinitions, and managing history files for subpanel layouts.

classes.name: DeployedSubpanelImplementation
classes.description: Manages the deployment and configuration of subpanels for a specific module in SuiteCRM, including loading from history, saving updates, and integrating with the module's subpanel definitions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the object with subpanel and module names, loads existing definitions, and retrieves or restores subpanel configuration.

methods.name: deploy
methods.description: Saves a provided layout definition, updates the subpanel, and manages history for version tracking.

methods.name: getFileName
methods.description: Constructs and returns the full path filename for a specific view, module, and metadata type.

methods.name: getLanguage
methods.description: Returns the language associated with the subpanel; the language is derived from the subpanel's template instance.
